name: Jev
tagline: Frontier-intelligence function call: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out
knowledge: Common-sense judgment; not a knowledge-cutoff chat model

pricing.note: Charged per input token. Output tokens are free.

rate_limits.note: Limits can change without notice during early access.

training.method: RLCD — Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions
training.note: Same weights for every account. Shape answers via state, instructions, and criteria.

language.other: Handled but not equally well; test and watch confidence.

operator_gotchas: Jev does not generate text, code, or explanations
Question IDs are for your code; they are not sent to the model
Noul has no separate confidence field — the probability is the signal
Questions in one request are independent; dependencies need a second call
Do not count, do arithmetic, or compare dates in the model — keep that in code
Accuracy falls as unrelated state grows (context rot)
Cannot LoRA / fine-tune; customize through the request
Pin jev-1.13.0 if you have tuned thresholds against that version
disclaimer: Unofficial community showcase. Specs from TypeSafe docs and the 15 Sep 2026 announcement. Not affiliated with TypeSafe AI.
